import { CreateNoteHandler, ListNotesHandler } from "{{scope}}/notebook/application";
import { InMemoryCreateNoteStore, InMemoryDatabase, InMemoryListNotesStore } from "{{scope}}/notebook/adapters/in-memory";
import { createNotebookRouter, type NotebookRouter } from "{{scope}}/notebook/adapters/trpc";

// The one place that decides which adapter backs which port.
export function composeApp(): NotebookRouter {
  const db = new InMemoryDatabase();

  return createNotebookRouter({
    createNote: new CreateNoteHandler(new InMemoryCreateNoteStore(db)),
    listNotes: new ListNotesHandler(new InMemoryListNotesStore(db)),
  });
}
